name: Power-law memory (retention of energy injected at a layer's birth)
summary: gasket R2 pow 0.967 vs exp 1.000; tree pow 0.997 vs exp 0.941 (k = 1..4, alpha divided out)
criterion: Wave (alpha = 0.005, beta = 0.05, no sink, no drive); gasket grown from level 3 to level 7 with G = 200 steps between growths; unit energy injected on each newly born layer; R(k) = energy remaining on that layer's vertices k growth steps later, averaged over layers, with the known factor exp(-2 alpha k G dt) divided out. Over k = 1..4: gasket R2_powerlaw > R2_exponential AND tree (branch 3) R2_exponential >= R2_powerlaw. Lattice control (no growth, elapsed time in units of G) is reported.

metrics.alpha_correction: R(k) multiplied by exp(2 alpha k G dt) before fitting

notes: Protocol: levels 3->7, G = 200 steps (dt = 0.05) between growths and after the last one, alpha = 0.005, beta = 0.05, no drive, no sink. Each newly born layer (the level-3 vertices at t = 0, then every new layer) receives unit energy |a_i|^2 = 1/n_s with independent uniform random phases, averaged over 4 draws; R_s(k) is measured on that layer's vertices after k epochs of G steps. Correction: every R_s(k) is multiplied by exp(2 alpha tau), tau = k G dt, which removes the known uniform decay exp(-2 alpha G k) exactly (alpha I commutes with L); fits use the corrected R over k = 1..4. The coherent (equal-phase) injection is reported but not judged: its constant-mode part never decays under beta L and dilutes as the graph grows. Gasket R2 pow 0.967 vs exp 1.000 (FAIL); tree exp 0.941 vs pow 0.997 (FAIL).

name: Harmonicity rises: Stuart-Landau (headline)
summary: harmonicity_osc gasket 0.443->0.354 (p=0.813); vs complete 0.095 (p=0.0148); mu0 p=1
criterion: Gasket grown from level 2 to level 5 (G = 500 steps per level); stuart_landau with omega by depth and noise sigma = 0.05 at the frontier; 5 seeds; harmonicity_osc at the frontier with the 3-way spectral clusters recomputed after each growth. Pass: end - start > 0 with one-sided paired t-test p < 0.05; AND gasket end > complete-graph (same N) end with p < 0.05; AND the mu = 0 control shows no significant rise. A pass on E4b or E4c passes E4.
notes: stuart_landau: mu = 1, omega_i = 1 + 1 depth/d_max, c = 1, alpha = 0, beta = 0.02, noise sigma = 0.05 at the newest layer; null control mu = 0. Start/end = means over the first and last growth epochs (G = 500 steps; levels 2 and 5); frontier = depth >= d_max - 1. Clusters = 3-way spectral clusters of the gasket, recomputed after each growth; n_clusters_eff merges cluster frequencies whose phases drift apart by less than 1 rad over the last 200 steps. Complete-graph control: same vertices, depths, frequencies, noise and clusters, coupled through K_N with uniform weight (gasket mean degree)/(N - 1); the V1 harmonicity variants use the gasket's modes in every condition. Pass: low_subspace_fraction (modes k <= k_gap, the first spectral gap; 3 on the gasket) >= 0.9 at the end of phase 1 AND <= 0.5 throughout the second half of phase 2.
notes: Gamma_sink off; exact modal integrator. Gasket level 5, alpha = 0.02, beta = 0.05, dt = 0.05. k_gap = 3 (lambda_4/lambda_3 = 4.96). Phase 1 = predicted global-collapse time 1/(2 beta lambda_2) = 1741.6 (34832 steps) without drive from a random state; modes above the gap fall behind the low subspace on the time scale 1/(2 beta (lambda_4 - lambda_2)) = 439.9.
